headline: CORNELL 🏛️ FRAT 🍆 RAPE Accuser UNDER 🛡️ SIEGE Online 📱
text:
LAWYER 🧑‍⚖️ for the Jane Doe 🍑 at Cornell 🏫 frat 🏠 house says she's "not doing well" 😵 amid brutal 🛡️ attempts to UNCOVER 🕵️ her identity 🪪 while she's getting absolutely RAILED 💦 by online sleuths 🕵️‍♂️ hunting her down like prey 🦌!! Thomas Giuffra 🍝 dropped that his client was "incapable of consent" 🚫 because she showed up "completely grossly intoxicated" 🥴 at the Ithaca 🏙️ house where the alleged assault 🍑 took place in 2024 📅, leaving her "under siege" 🏰 on social media 📲 where randos keep trying to dox her name 🏷️!! "She's under siege" 🛡️ he told CNN 📺 straight up while random women keep getting misidentified 🆘 as the real Jane Doe in this mess that has the whole campus 🏛️ down bad 😩 after no charges 🧾 were filed at first until her civil lawsuit 📜 blew it back open like a surprise climax 🌋 reigniting criminal 🔥 possibilities big time!!

This poor 20-year-old 🍑 was "pressured" 😣 into taking ketamine 💊 before the seven men 👥 allegedly turned her into their plaything 🧸 at the frat 🍻 bash according to Giuffra 🗣️ who keeps hammering she was "a sex doll for all intents" 🪆 and "felt like bait" 🪝 with the attackers circling "like lions" 🦁 around her per the disciplinary files 📂 that got leaked to media 📺!! New York Governor Kathy Hochul 👩‍⚖️ just appointed Attorney General Letitia James 🦸 to TAKE OVER 🏋️ the whole investigation 🔎 after she "lost faith" 🙅 in the county prosecutor 🧑‍⚖️ because this young woman already endured something "utterly unspeakable" 😱 and then got failed by every institution 🏛️ that was supposed to protect her shield 🛡️!! Hochul also vowed to close that ridiculous "loophole" 🚪 in state law 📜 that makes it hard to press rape charges 🛑 if the victim voluntarily downs alcohol 🍹 or drugs 💊 which is basically edging the whole justice system ⚖️ into oblivion rn!!

Social feeds 📲 are now flooded 🌊 with women posting videos 🎥 of themselves screaming "I am Jane Doe" 🗣️ to shield the real accuser's identity 🪪 and mess up internet searches 🔎 while also dropping their own sexual assault stories 📖 in solidarity 🤝 after some political commentator 🗣️ vowed to unmask her claiming it's unfair the Cornell Seven 🧔‍♂️ stay publicly named even without charges 🧾!! Online sleuths 🕵️ have been doxxing addresses 🏠 of the so-called Cornell Seven leading to at least one horrific case of mistaken identity 🆘 where an active-duty US Marine Corps sergeant 🪖 with the same name got served the lawsuit 📜 by accident!! That poor Marine then got hit with a TORRENT 🌊 of abuse and threats ☠️ according to reports leaving everyone watching this saga 🧩 completely cooked 🍳 while the actual Jane Doe hides from the siege 🏰 that's destroying her right now!!

Giuffra 🧑‍⚖️ keeps stressing in every interview 🎤 that his client arrived already "grossly intoxicated" 🥴 and "incapable of consent" 🚫 after being pressured into ketamine 💉 before the alleged gang assault 🍑 at the frat house 🏠 which has now thrust the entire Cornell 🏫 community into national spotlight 🔦 with students voicing frustration 😤 at public hearings 🗣️ over how badly this was handled from jump!! The governor's move 👑 to hand it to the top prosecutor 🦸‍♀️ signals total loss of faith 🙅 in local authorities after they dropped the ball 🏈 initially when no charges were filed despite her vivid description of feeling like "bait" 🪝 surrounded by "lions" 🦁 turning her into a "sex doll" 🪆 which is just heartbreaking 💔 but the online mob 🧟 keeps hunting anyway!! This whole situation has everyone from Ithaca 🏙️ to Albany 🏛️ questioning the system ⚙️ while women band together online 🤝 posting solidarity clips 🎞️ to protect Jane Doe from the digital siege 🛡️ that's clearly leaving her "not doing well" at all rn!!
